text:
Maya (AE): Heads-up: Prospect wants BYOK with cloud HSM in their AWS account, FIPS 140-2 L3, no plaintext key material leaving their env. They asked for: POC checklist, sample key policy, estimate of any per-key/month charge, and timeline to go Private+HSM.
Leo (Solutions Eng): Good. I'll sketch a lean POC that shows encrypt/decrypt + rotation and a failover to non-HSM demo mode.
Priya (Security): Two immediate controls: require CloudTrail+KMS logs forwarded to their log account, and key policy denying DeleteKey/Cancel. Also need to confirm whether they require split-knowledge for key ceremonies.
Julian (SRE): For Private/VPC deployment we'll need peering/VPN details or the Transit GW setup, and an IAM role ARN for our service principal. Also maintenance windows for rotation.
Maya (AE): They specifically asked whether HSM-backed CMKs incur a separate monthly fee vs only usage billing.
Julian (SRE): Short answer: HSM licensing/hosting is charged when we integrate a partner HSM for a customer (Private or Dedicated). For a BYOK cloud-HSM in the customer's account we typically pass through the AWS CloudHSM cost plus a small integration SOW fee. Hosted (shared keys) has no per-customer HSM line. I'll add numbers to the SOW ticket.
Leo (Solutions Eng): POC runbook draft (please add security/ops notes):
```
POC runbook - minimal
1) Customer creates AWS KMS CMK (HSM-backed) in their AWS account and tags it for Redwood-POC.
2) Customer adds a Key Policy granting the Redwood service principal or role permission for Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey.
3) Provide us the CMK ARN and an IAM role we can assume (or a KMS grant).
4) Run sample encrypt/decrypt via Redwood API against that CMK. Validate ciphertext rewrap and latency.
5) Execute rotation: rotate alias to a new key/rotate key material, validate decryption of previously encrypted objects (rewrap step if required).
6) Simulate outage: revoke grant and confirm fallback behavior to demo soft-key (clearly labeled).
```
Priya (Security): Addenda: require kms:ViaService or Condition on aws:SourceAccount/aws:SourceVpc where possible; define monitoring alerts for kms:Decrypt errors; agree on retention for CloudTrail events (we ask 90 days by default). For split-knowledge/on-prem HSMs we can support multi-person ceremony — detail in SOW.
Maya (AE): Can we provide a one-page summary for procurement that lists cost lines (HSM pass-through, integration SOW, monthly ops fee)?
Julian (SRE): Yes. Example stub: "HSM pass-through: estimate $Y/month (AWS CloudHSM) billed by customer; Integration SOW: one-time $Z for network + key ceremony; Private hosting ops: recurring $W/month." I'll make precise numbers after scoping (ticket created).
Leo (Solutions Eng): Example key policy snippet we can give them to start (they should adapt principle ARNs):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-service"},
      "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],
      "Resource": "*",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceAccount": "123456789012"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
Priya (Security): Also recommend adding an explicit Deny for kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion with an exception process defined in SOW.
Maya (AE): Timeline: customer wants kickoff within three weeks. What's realistic for Private + CloudHSM BYOK?
Julian (SRE): If they supply account access, network, and security contact promptly: 5-7 weeks for Private+CloudHSM. If they require on-prem HSM procurement and onsite ceremonies: add 4-6 weeks.
Leo (Solutions Eng): Operational note: if customer forbids any key material leaving their account, Hosted is not an option. We'll need Redwood Private or an on-prem integration. Mention this explicitly in the SOW options.
Maya (AE): They also submitted a security questionnaire item about key escrow and backups 144E any templated response?
Priya (Security): Templated answers: we do not hold escrow copies unless customer requests and contractually authorizes it; backups of customer CMKs are managed by their KMS provider (AWS), and we can document procedures for CMK rotation and re-encryption of stored objects. For escrow or split-knowledge, we require explicit SOW and an approved key ceremony plan.
Maya (AE): Great. Can someone pull together the runbook + procurement stub + questionnaire answers into a single pack for the kickoff?
Leo (Solutions Eng): I'll produce the POC one-pager and sample payloads. ETA: EOD tomorrow.
Julian (SRE): I'll draft the SOW cost stub and initial ops checklist; creating ticket INF-4556 for cost estimates.
Priya (Security): I'll attach the curated questionnaire responses and mark any high-risk asks.
deploy-bot: Ticket INF-4556 created: "HSM integration cost estimate & SOW draft".
Maya (AE): Thanks all. Action items: Leo (POC doc), Julian (cost/SOW stub), Priya (sec answers). I'll schedule kickoff once pack is ready.
Leo (Solutions Eng): One more technical question to confirm with customer: do they want alias-based rotation (transparent) or rewrap-on-rotate for existing ciphertext? That affects downtime and test steps.
Maya (AE): I'll confirm preference in the kickoff invite.
Julian (SRE): FYI for the POC: we should include a test that measures KMS latency 95th/99th percentile to set realistic SLOs.
Maya (AE): Perfect, closing loop here. I'll post the assembled pack to this thread when complete. :white_check_mark:
